name: Ubukata Mizuho
source:
>Nurse

A nurse working in a clinic located at Iwamuro Village.

She used to work in a big hospital in a large city, but wanting to work at a regional clinic where she can get closer to patients, she moved to this village.

Mizuho has a gentle and dedicated personality, and thanks to which she has already blended in among the locals. She is capable of following anyone's conversation whether they are young or old and is loved by all. One of the things she's great at is massage, and when elderly people come to the clinic she often massages their shoulders which they greatly enjoy.

Since it's hard to say that the clinic can respond to the needs of the village, she would like to improve its facilities and equipment.

She's a resident of Iwamuro Village.

[Translated and edited from [url=http://www.guilty-soft.com/product/natsuyo/character2.html]Official Site[/url]]
